description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application runtime and framework baseline to the latest supported Java framework level.
tasks.reason: The current Java 11 + javax servlet baseline is outdated for long-term Azure modernization and supportability.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project to the latest supported Java framework baseline and align application/runtime compatibility so downstream Azure modernization tasks can proceed.

tasks.description: Modernize secret and sensitive configuration handling using Azure cloud-native services.
tasks.reason: The current application relies on plaintext-style environment/property credential flow that should be modernized for secure cloud operations.
tasks.requirements: Migrate application secrets and sensitive connection settings to Azure Key Vault using Azure-native access patterns.

tasks.description: Modernize database connectivity to Azure-native managed identity authentication.
tasks.reason: Cloud-native service modernization requires passwordless, identity-based access for Azure database services.
tasks.requirements: Migrate database access authentication to Managed Identity for Azure SQL to support cloud-native security and operations.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before Azure deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required to ensure the modernized workload is safe for production deployment.
tasks.requirements: Scan all dependencies for CVEs, upgrade to patched versions, document breaking-change risk for major upgrades, and confirm build/test health after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The project goal explicitly requires deploying the modernized application to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the application to Azure Container Apps with production-ready runtime configuration and service connectivity.
